details: The package's preinstall hook runs index.js, which executes a curl POST to the interactsh callback host 5f8a1ed70fb7761d678agw9bucryyyyyb[.]oast[.]site at path /verify-cli/$(whoami)/$(hostname)/. The request body is a base64-encoded dump of /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, the output of `id`, and an attempted read of /etc/shadow, sent with a custom User-Agent. This exfiltrates the installer's system identity and credential files at install time. The package also declares a dependency on the known-malicious package noderedacteddk.
